summary: @onereach/or-sdk-agent-cli preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes an obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package's declared preinstall script runs setup.mjs, which downloads the Bun runtime from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<version>/<archive>.zip, extracts it to a temporary directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it against math_init.js — a 727 KB obfuscator.io-style bundle shipped in the tarball. Both setup.mjs and math_init.js are heavily obfuscated (hex identifier renaming in setup.mjs; shuffled string-array decoder with rotation function in math_init.js). The package presents itself as a documentation/CLI wrapper for the OneReach SDK and has no stated need for a second runtime; using a freshly-downloaded alien runtime to execute an obfuscated bundled script at install time bypasses Node-based inspection and runs arbitrary shipped bytes against the installer's machine on npm install.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
